title: Single-cell RNA-sequencing reveals the heterogeneity of microglia in fibrous membrane derived from proliferative diabetic retinopathy and proliferative vitreoretinopathy
PVR-FM
data_processing: Novaseq 6000 software used for basecalling.

After removing R1 reads without poly-T tails, the cell barcodes and unique molecular identifiers (UMIs) were extracted. Meanwhile, the R2 reads were mapped to reference genome hg38 (STAR v2.5.4a and featureCounts 1.6.2) using Star (version 2.5.2b) reference.
Genome_build: hg38
Supplementary_files_format_and_content: Matrix table with raw gene counts for every gene and every cells
